text: 6/20/2016		 Dear Mr. [INSERT LAST NAME],  We regret to inform you that the [INSERT CHAPTER NAME] Chapter of Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia Fraternity has voted to EXPEL you from the Fraternity. This vote for expulsion occurred during the Chapter’s business meeting on [INSERT DATE]. The chapter has taken this action for the following reason(s):  [INSERT REASONS FOR DISCIPLINE HERE]  (Examples:  Failure to pay a chapter financial obligation Failure to meet minimum academic performance standards Persistent unexcused absences from chapter meetings or events Disregard for the Chapter’s welfare Other reasonable causes [EXPLAIN]) This action is in accordance with the National Constitution and Bylaws Title III, Article IX, Section 1: “Section 1. Reasons for discipline. For conduct which is harmful to the best interests or good name of the Fraternity, the chapter may expel any of its collegiate members from the Fraternity. If such conduct does not warrant expulsion, the chapter may place any of its collegiate members on suspension.”  You are no longer considered a member of Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia Fraternity and have forfeited all rights of membership. Please be aware that all monies paid to the chapter, province, and national fraternity are non-refundable. Please turn in all emblems and insignia of membership by [INSERT DATE].  You may appeal this expulsion to the National Executive Committee (NEC) at any time. To begin this process please contact Lyrecrest at 812-867-2433 ext. 100    Sincerely,    [INSERT NAME] [INSERT CHAPTER NAME] Secretary    [INSERT NAME] [INSERT CHAPTER NAME] President
